take: Our team dug into why ground-applied retardant is so underutilized despite being incredibly effective — and why it deserves a permanent place in initial attack, contingency planning, and prescribed fire doctrine, not just aerial delivery.

title: ‘We have a problem’: NTSB report details final moments before Utah firefighting helicopter crash
take: The preliminary NTSB finding is that the helitanker “struck rising terrain” during a water mission — a sobering reminder that terrain awareness and mission-brief discipline can never become routine. Exactly the kind of finding that belongs in every program's next AAR, not just the operator involved.

title: 2 Killed in Mid-Air Helicopter Crash During Fire Fight in Greece
take: Cause is still under investigation, but a mid-air collision between two firefighting helicopters working the same fire is a hard reminder of what's at stake. Rigorous airspace deconfliction, air-to-air communication discipline, and multi-aircraft coordination training are never optional once more than one aircraft is working a fire.

title: Production of Europe's First Sikorsky FIREHAWK Helicopters Begins in Poland
take: The Firehawk's first deployment outside the U.S., built for the Czech Republic's RescEU program. Once one European operator stands up a Firehawk program, it becomes the template every other agency on the continent studies — including how they train and support it.

title: Governor Newsom Announces Expansion of the World's Largest Civilian Aerial Firefighting Fleet
take: A fourth C-130H and an 11th helitack base for CAL FIRE. Worth watching how staffing, training, and program development keep pace with the hardware — that gap, not the aircraft count, is usually where a growing program actually struggles.

title: Aviation Specialties Unlimited Recognizes E3 Early Adopters
take: Over 1,100 units sold and now expanding into Alpine operations. Night vision equipment decisions like this ripple straight into training curriculum and currency requirements for any program flying after dark.
